title: Greedy packing: fractional knapsack
summary: Maximize value in a weight-limited bag when items can be divided. Supply nonnegative values, positive weights and nonnegative capacity.
code: ranked = sorted(items, key=lambda item: item[0] / item[1], reverse=True)
triggers: divisible items under a weight budget
each unit of an item has the same marginal value
prompts: Fill a tanker from divisible lots of oil with different values per litre.
A recycler can take fractions of material batches. Maximize the value within the truck’s weight limit.
invariant: Each unit taken has at least as much value as any unit still available.
mantra: Sort by value per unit and fill from the richest lot.
pitfalls: The greedy choice relies on the ability to split the last item. Whole-item packing requires a different argument.

anchors.name: Fractional Knapsack
anchors.trick: A unit of a higher-density item can replace a lower-density unit at the same weight.

mutations.explanation: Packs a whole item even when only a fraction fits.
